// 1. Go to Firebase Console
// 2. Navigate to Firestore Database
// 3. Click "Create collection" 
// 4. Enter collection name: "tbl_users"
// 5. Add a document with the above fields
// 6. The collection will be created automatically when the first document is added

// To manually add a user in Firebase Console:
// 1. Click "Add document" in tbl_users collection
// 2. Add fields:
//    - Field: fullnameAT, Type: String, Value: (user's name)
//    - Field: emailAT, Type: String, Value: (user's email)
//    - Field: passwordAT, Type: String, Value: (user's password)
//    - Field: createdAT, Type: Timestamp, Value: (current date/time)
// 3. Click Save
